_setup: 1. console.cloud.google.com: create (or pick) a project and enable the Google Sheets API.
2. IAM & Admin > Service accounts: create one, then Keys > Add key > JSON. Save it at the 'credentials' path above (never inside this repo).
3. Open the spreadsheet and Share it with the service account's e-mail (client_email in the key file) as Editor.
4. Test: .venv/bin/python live/market_sheet.py   (env MOMENTUM_GSHEET_CREDENTIALS overrides the key path)
